paid_generation_policy: Vera/model generation allowed only for source visual creation after a bounded canary passes; slicing, normalization, alignment, recolor masks, packaging, and validation must be deterministic.
selection_rule: Use evenly distributed stable logical IDs across the original 001-120 ledger, then assign deliberately varied silhouettes so V1 maximizes wardrobe breadth rather than near-duplicates.

art_direction: RPG Maker MV cover-art / MV Trinity-inspired JRPG polish without copying proprietary art
clean anime/JRPG readability at sprite scale
fabric, stitch, thread, charm and handcrafted motifs
Chinese, Japanese and Victorian influences balanced across the set
normal anatomy and body-safe overlay geometry
avoid baked-in skin so every top remains compatible with locked Creator Body and Skin layers
canary_rule: Do not launch bulk Tops until all three canaries pass source-art review, alpha/body-fit validation on locked narrow/median/broad Creator Bodies, movement-grid validation, and duplicate-silhouette review.
bulk_rule: After canary pass, produce only the remaining selected V1 IDs; never auto-expand to all 120 without explicit user instruction.
